commit.message: fix(pending): fail closed on unverifiable approvals (MAGI-003)

specification.objective: MAGI-003: fail closed for invalid or unverifiable pending approvals, including list/read status and backend validation at the moment of mutation, without preventing rejections.

requirements.statement: Failure to read MemoryStore reports unknown can_apply false with safe explanation.
Validate each record structurally via MagiReview.validate_record before approving, including approve all; invalid ones do not call native approval.
For replace and remove require usable matched_entry pins and current entry existence; native Hermes mutation remains final concurrency authority.
Other eligible batch records continue, result per-item failures per MAGI-002, and reject remains available for invalid or obsolete records.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Storage-read failure disables approval in list/detail and returns unknown state.
Malformed/unpinned/missing records in bulk are blocked while valid siblings apply.
Native race failure after precheck propagates failed result; rejecting unverifiable proposal works.
Existing suite, verify.sh and POLIS gates pass.

invariants.statement: Never bypass Hermes public pending approval API, do not create atomic full snapshot guarantee.
Reject remains authorized despite unverifiable store; valid approvals unaffected.

forbidden_states.statement: Any malformed or missing-pin destructive record invokes native approval.
Read error presents can_apply true or reports phantom success.

inputs.statement: TASKS.md MAGI-003, read/approve code and previously implemented MAGI-002 outcomes.

outputs.statement: Fail-closed status and approval precheck with per-record error handling and regressions.

failure_semantics.statement: Precheck is advisory; any concurrent native conflict is reported as failure; no atomic snapshot claims.
